en: Miles Edgeworth! You might have plenty of time on your hands, but I'm a busy woman!
old_src: Майлз Эджворт! У тебя, может, времени и навалом, а я женщина занятая!

en: Oh, is there? Then perhaps you'd care to explain it to me?

en: Indeed. I won't make the mistake of letting her swing that thing at me again.

en: (I'd better get this over with before she whips Fender unconscious...)

en: ...y'all better have some tasty bait on that hook. By which I mean scoops! And plenty of 'em!
